ordonnance.definition: A pencil of straight lines that either concur at a common point or are mutually parallel (concurrent at an ideal point at infinity).

hexagrammum-mysticum.definition: The complete projective configuration of six points on a conic section and the sixty Pascal lines formed by the intersections of opposite sides of the inscribed hexagons.

droite-de-pascal.definition: The straight line passing through the three points of intersection of opposite sides of a hexagon inscribed in a conic section.

point-de-steiner.definition: One of twenty points in the Hexagrammum Mysticum web at which three Pascal lines concur, corresponding to two points per complementary bi-triangle partition of the six conic vertices.

point-de-kirkman.definition: One of sixty points in the Hexagrammum Mysticum web where three Pascal lines concur in a second, distinct incidence configuration dual to Pascal lines.

droite-de-pluecker.definition: One of fifteen straight lines in the Hexagrammum Mysticum web, each containing exactly four of the twenty Steiner points.

birapport.definition: The fundamental projective invariant (A, B; C, D) = (AC/CB) / (AD/DB) preserved under central and conic projections.

conique.definition: A planar curve of degree two formed by intersecting a right or oblique cone with a plane: circle, ellipse, parabola, hyperbola, or degenerate line-pair.
